recorded_obligations: the 22-parent endgame has a neck: execution/v2.4/parent_gate_frontier.json shows W00-99 the only ACCEPTED gate card and W01-99 the only gate whose dependencies are met - W02-99 needs W01-99, W03-99 needs W02-99, W04-99 needs W03-99, and W05/W06/W07/W08/W09-99 hang behind those. Prioritise the neck over breadth: 17 cards and 42 cases cannot close around it

W09-01 L-1/L-2 (gates W09-99): three legs of RecordEvidenceOrigin are falsified by nothing - the origin content_hash leg (evidence_origin.go:43, verifier O06), the subject currency leg (O02) and the origin kind leg (O04). Close with three fixture rows: an origin over a DIFFERENT sealed body carrying the same artifact id, an annotation on a STALE/REVOKED subject, and a citation of a SIMULATED origin; each expects 422 GATE_FAILED with the named message.

W09-01 L-6/L-8 (gates W09-99): the DB-backed branch of searchEvidence is never exercised because every W0901 fixture seals through a local root, so removing the uploaded-body digest comparison (R07) stays green and no test in the tracked tree expects the text 'sealed snapshot unavailable'. The three live-hash witnesses are redundant with each other and only the pair removal P01 reaches the roster.

W09-01 L-7 (gates W09-99): the adapter's own escape guards are not what refuses the cross-project attack. Removing !filepath.IsLocal (A01), the registered-root identity comparison (A02) or the missing-identity precondition (A03) each survived, and removing A01+A02 together (P04) still left all 31 ids green - Go's os.OpenRoot containment is doing the refusing. A card that claims the adapter's guards needs its own negative path around OpenRoot.

W09-01 L-9 (line-level): the handler's locked sha256, version_output and isabs legs are unfalsified by the roster (H09/H10/H11 survived). Behaviour was re-established by decoy probes, not by an assertion, so a regression that swaps the pinned go for another absolute path would pass.

W09-01 L-11 (host safety): the W0901_PROBE_DEPTH cap is load-bearing and unasserted as a cap. H03 (rename the marker, route intact) survived because the child refuses before reaching the probe; P05 (marker renamed AND route broken) recursed to 36 concurrent python.exe before the reviewer's 45s wall, needing 8 stragglers killed match-by-command-line. Any later card that touches the self-probe must keep the cap and must not reuse this mutant without its own cap.

W09-01 L-12: action 1's 'revision' is only half verified - W0901-EVIDENCE-ROW-CARRIES-* asserts upstream_revision is PRESENT and NIL, and no fixture carries a real upstream revision; GITHUB/X/PAPER canonical-URL and origin-allow-list refusal in createEvidence is not in this card's 31.

W09-01 L-4 (PLAN GAP, needs an owner decision, not a fix): 'Sirchmunk只在固定源码资格合格后替代适配器' has no owner anywhere in the 71-step plan. W09-01 is the only step that mentions Sirchmunk and 'sirchmunk' exists in the product only as the literal "NOT_SELECTED" at ops/ci/retrieval.py:107; W09-99's write_scope is receipts/step_state/checkpoint only, so no defined card can add the field or the state. Either a card gains that scope or W09-99 must sign action 4's second half as explicitly out of product scope. Do not paper over it by narrowing the card text.

W09-01 L-5 (gates W09-99 deliverable 1): deliverable 1's 'every item of an answer traces to a concrete original fragment' is proved for the RETRIEVAL half only. No W0901 id traces an assembled answer or a ContextBundle citation to a fragment, and this binding never enters currentAuthorizedSnapshots / validateBundleSnapshots / materialize (that is why R02 and R09 survive). W09-99's A06/C19 signature must cover the answer path.

W09-01 defect (mine, from review P4 + correction C-4): tests/evidence/check/main.py serve() creates execution/v2.4/receipts/W09/W09-01/dispatched/<uuid4>/ before it knows whether the run writes anything, so every refused-binding dispatch and every aborted mutant leaves an empty directory: measured 796 dirs, 694 of them empty. Create the directory lazily at the first write. Nothing was deleted: part of that tree is evidence the product wrote under another identity's run.

W09-02 L-1/L-2 (gates W09-99): the reviewed rows on the cache key's legs were mis-attributed and are fixed in 36ebdfb9, but the matrix buckets (6 caught / 7 survived) describe 7415ebf8, not the remediated tree. A re-run with the corrected guard would refuse M12 instead of reporting it as a survival. Re-measure before citing.

W09-02 L-3: three containment legs are asserted by nothing - removing !filepath.IsLocal outright leaves the roster green because os.Root refuses the same escape anyway, and classifyOpen's intermediate-component and ModeSymlink branches have no input either. A card that wants them needs a construction that reaches the pre-check without os.Root also refusing.

W09-02 L-6: source_kind is on the shared evidence summary, not on a client projection. No HTTP route exposes EvidenceSupportSummary, its only non-test reader is the ADOPT gate in candidates.go, and apps/web renders source_kind from the Evidence row. Action 3's 'same CLI/Desktop projection' is therefore undelivered and needs the card that owns the projection route.

W09-02 L-7 (SECURITY, open): a hard link into a registered root is sealed and served (os.link, st_nlink=2, outside content readable). Deliberately not fixed here: the fix (ByHandleFileInformation.NumberOfLinks in adapters/retrieval/local.go) would also refuse legitimate hard-linked user content, which is a product decision, not a test gap. Decide before W09-99 signs C19.

W09-02 L-9 (plan defect, registry owner): test.security --task-id W09 --check-id W09-02 is dead under both v2.4 and legacy resolution - the v2.4 entry routes only W17/W17-01 to a host-boundary program that reads no environment at all, and the legacy entry routes W09 through the gate id W09-G02 - and W09-99 declares the same unresolvable pair. Until the registry owner re-points the plan or gives W09-99 a routed handler, every card in the W09 line must deviate the way this one did, and each deviation compounds.

W09-02 L-10: the live qualification/v2.4/evidence/W01-G03.json now disagrees with accepted card W01-99's registered frozen copy on checks[3].ok and on the installed_desktop_present blocker. No digest gate covers the live file. Before W01-99 is worked, re-run its driver deliberately and reconcile the two, rather than letting the gate card read a record that contradicts its own receipt.

W09-02 P-8 (precedent, line-level): this card self-registered its own registry key. commands.json is owned by W00-02/W02-02 and the binding line says W02 registers the selector before use; W07-01, W07-02, W08-01, W09-01 and now W09-02 have all appended under disclosure. The practice is stable but it is not the plan, and a line where every slice self-binds its key has effectively moved registry ownership without saying so.

W10-01 P5/L1 owner decision: declared key test.experiments is still NOT_IMPLEMENTED (exit 3, 0 assertions) while the card was accepted on the sibling key at registry revision 23, which is outside the card's four write_scope entries; the W09-02 rev 22 precedent is precedent, not authorisation
